meta.name: Pritam and Pedro
meta.description: The dynamic between the two contrasting personalities, a seasoned cop who prefers old-school methods and a tech-savvy cop who relies on modern technology for investigations, as they navigate their partnership in solving crimes.

videos.title: Punishment Posting
videos.overview: A 'worthless' tape recorder goes missing, which Pritam wants back. Pedro gets dumped in the cyber cell and wants to go back to the crime branch. When they meet, they strike a deal.

videos.title: The Missing Boy
videos.overview: Pedro sees his one shot at redemption when the Sports Minister's son is kidnapped. But as the case goes out of his control, Pedro makes a decision he can't undo.

videos.title: The Blackmail
videos.overview: While Pedro chases control, Pritam chases logic. With Vinny still missing, their efforts reveal an unsettling truth - the case is moving on someone else's terms.

videos.title: The Blue Whale
videos.overview: Digging into Vinny's secret online game, Pedro and Pritam uncover a digital maze. A subtle discovery rattles the family, as Pritam's past creeps closer than he expects.

videos.title: Catch Me If You Can
videos.overview: Pedro wants to catch a criminal, but Pritam wants to track a mind. The hunt flips, turning the case into a cat-and-mouse game where Pedro isn't sure who is chasing whom.

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: Time's up! Is Martin really their guy? Pritam, Pedro and the entire police squad better act quick… before Vinny loses his life.
